styles.name: [Finish] Colour Banding
styles.nl: Banding finish: stepped bands across smooth gradients, posterised skies, visible tonal quantisation, material style image.
styles.negative: smooth continuous gradients, deep bit depth

styles.name: [Finish] JPEG Artefacts
styles.nl: Compression finish: blocky 8-pixel artefacts around edges, ringing halos, banded flat areas, muddied fine detail, material style image.

styles.name: [Finish] Screen Door
styles.nl: Screen-door finish: fine dark grid between pixels, RGB subpixel fringing, slight display glow, material style image.

styles.name: [Finish] Upscale Mush
styles.nl: Upscaled finish: over-smoothed surfaces with hallucinated micro-detail, waxy texture, halos along strong edges, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] 3D Print Layer Lines
styles.nl: FDM rendering: visible horizontal layer lines, support scars, slight stringing, matte filament sheen, stepped overhangs, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Anaglyph Stereo
styles.nl: Anaglyph rendering: red and cyan channels offset apart, ghosted double edges, desaturated middle tones, faint print misregistration, material style image.
styles.negative: clean single-channel colour, sharp modern rendering

styles.name: [Experimental] Analog Paper Collage
styles.nl: Paper-collage rendering: torn and scissor-cut edges, layered magazine stock, visible glue wrinkle and drop shadow, mixed halftone textures, collage style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Anthotype Plant Emulsion
styles.nl: Anthotype rendering: crushed petal juice coated on paper and bleached by weeks of sun, pale magenta or spinach-green monochrome, soft undefined edges, uneven brush-coated border, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] ASCII Text Picture
styles.nl: ASCII rendering: image built from monospaced characters, density-mapped tonal ramp, terminal green or grey on black, aliased character grid, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Batik Wax Resist
styles.nl: Batik rendering: wax-resist outlines with crackle veins, layered dye baths, earthy saturated colour on cotton weave, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Beadwork Loom
styles.nl: Beadwork rendering: image built from strung glass beads on a grid, stepped colour blocks, tiny specular glints, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Cellular Automata Grid
styles.nl: Automata rendering: a cell grid stepped through one simple rule, triangular growth fronts and repeating fractal wedges, hard black-or-white cells with no anti-aliasing, rigid pixel lattice, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Ceramic Glaze Illustration
styles.nl: Glazed-ceramic rendering: pooled glossy glaze over matte clay body, crackle craze lines, kiln colour shifts, soft specular sheen, material style image.
styles.negative: flat vector fill, dry paper texture

styles.name: [Experimental] Chalkboard
styles.nl: Chalkboard rendering: dusty white chalk on dark slate, smudged erasure ghosts, gritty granular strokes, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] CNC Toolpath
styles.nl: CNC rendering: concentric machining passes across the surface, stepped terracing, bit chatter marks, raw material grain, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Coffee Wash
styles.nl: Coffee-wash rendering: tannin-stained tonal washes on absorbent paper, hard tide lines at every dried edge, ring marks and granular sediment, warm sepia range only, material style image.
styles.negative: bright saturated pigment, flat digital fills

styles.name: [Experimental] Cross-Stitch Sampler
styles.nl: Cross-stitch rendering: X-shaped floss stitches on aida grid, stepped blocky colour, visible weave holes, slight thread sheen, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Crystal Growth
styles.nl: Crystal-growth rendering: faceted mineral clusters spreading over a surface, refracted internal light, sharp prismatic edges, material style image.

styles.nl: Cymatic rendering: fine sand gathered into nodal figures on a vibrating plate, symmetrical geometric lattices with soft mounded ridges, dark metal ground, raking light picking out the relief, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Delftware Blue
styles.nl: Delftware rendering: cobalt brushwork on white tin glaze, every tone drawn from one pigment, fine outline over broad wash, glaze pooling darker at the edges with a faint kiln crackle, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Dot-Matrix Print
styles.nl: Dot-matrix rendering: impact-printed dot rows, banded overlap, faded ribbon ink, tractor-feed paper texture, monochrome tonality, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] E-Ink Screen
styles.nl: E-ink rendering: matte grey-white substrate, dithered greyscale, no backlight, faint ghosting from the previous frame, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Ebru Marbling
styles.nl: Ebru rendering: combed pigment swirls on size, feathered tulip patterns, saturated interleaved colour veins, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Embroidery Needlepoint
styles.nl: Needlepoint rendering: raised satin-stitch floss, directional thread sheen, canvas showing at the edges, soft fibre halo, handmade style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Encaustic Wax
styles.nl: Encaustic rendering: pigmented wax fused in translucent layers, tool scrapes and drips, milky depth under a glossy skin, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Ethereal Motion Blur
styles.nl: Long-blur rendering: smeared directional streaks, dissolved edges, ghost trails through mid tones, soft luminous falloff, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Ferrofluid Spikes
styles.nl: Ferrofluid rendering: oily black liquid pulled into ordered spikes by a magnetic field, mirror-wet surface, sharp specular points along every peak, sterile studio reflection behind, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Flow-Field Streamlines
styles.nl: Flow-field rendering: thin curves each following an invisible vector field, strands bunching into eddies and thinning over open ground, uniform stroke weight throughout, pale unmarked paper behind, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Gelli Monoprint
styles.nl: Gelli-plate rendering: soft mottled ink pull, ghost layers from previous prints, mask silhouettes, uneven texture, print style image.
styles.negative: crisp digital print, even ink laydown

styles.name: [Experimental] Glitch Datamosh Still
styles.nl: Datamosh rendering: smeared macroblocks, channel displacement, frozen compression artefacts, banded colour tearing, video artefact style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Harmonograph Curve
styles.nl: Harmonograph rendering: interlaced pendulum loops drawn as one unbroken line, rosette symmetry drifting slowly out of true, ink tapering as the swing decays, faint warm paper tone behind, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Holographic Foil
styles.nl: Holographic-foil rendering: iridescent rainbow shift across a mirrored surface, hard specular banding, prismatic edge flare, embossed sheen, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Hydro-Dip Transfer
styles.nl: Hydro-dip rendering: a printed film floated on water and wrapped around a solid form, pattern stretching and pooling over every curve, seams meeting out of register, glossy clear coat over it, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Ink in Water
styles.nl: Ink-in-water rendering: diffusing pigment plumes, feathered tendrils, soft density gradients through clear fluid, dark-to-clear falloff, ink painting style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Khokhloma Lacquer

styles.name: [Experimental] Kids Crayon
styles.nl: Crayon rendering: waxy scribbled strokes, uneven pressure build-up, paper tooth showing through, out-of-register colour, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Kirigami Pop-Up
styles.nl: Kirigami rendering: card cut and folded into upright layers, crisp scored creases and hard cast shadows between planes, white stock with one accent colour, depth built from stepped tiers, handmade style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Lacquer Maki-e

styles.name: [Experimental] Latte Art

styles.name: [Experimental] LED Matrix

styles.name: [Experimental] Lenticular Print

styles.name: [Experimental] Light-Leak Overlay Photo

styles.name: [Experimental] Macramé Knotwork
styles.nl: Macramé rendering: knotted cord lattice, fringed loose ends, natural jute colour, soft shadow between the knots, handmade style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Mosaic Tesserae
styles.nl: Mosaic rendering: image broken into small irregular tiles, visible grout lines, stepped colour transitions, uneven glaze reflections, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Nail and Thread String Art
styles.nl: String-art rendering: coloured thread strung between panel pins, straight chords massing into curved moiré envelopes, thread crossings darkening the overlaps, stained board behind, handmade style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Neon Drip Abstract
styles.nl: Neon-drip rendering: glowing fluorescent runs over dark ground, blooming edges, wet paint sheen, high-chroma trails, abstract style image.
styles.negative: muted matte palette, precise line work

styles.name: [Experimental] Noise Contour Map
styles.nl: Noise-contour rendering: smooth pseudo-random terrain sliced into nested iso-lines, bands crowding tight where the slope steepens and opening out where it flattens, one ink weight on pale ground, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Papier-Mâché Folk Figure
styles.nl: Papier-mâché rendering: pulped paper forms with visible seams and lumps, matte poster colour in clashing bright patterns, dotted and striped decoration, uneven hand-finished edges, handmade style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Petri Dish Culture
styles.nl: Culture-plate rendering: colonies spreading across nutrient agar in concentric fringed rings, translucent gel catching light from below, velvety and glossy patches side by side, glass rim shadow, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Photomontage
styles.nl: Photomontage rendering: spliced photographic fragments at mismatched scale, hard cut seams, varied grain between pieces, flattened composite depth, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Pixel Sorting
styles.nl: Pixel-sort rendering: rows of pixels reordered by brightness, forms smearing sideways into ribbon bands, hard thresholds where sorting stops and starts, untouched blocks left intact between them, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Plotter Pen Generative
styles.nl: Pen-plotter rendering: single-weight ink strokes laid down by machine, thousands of parallel passes building tone by density, faint wobble and blob where each stroke starts, bare paper between the lines, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Pyrography Wood Burn
styles.nl: Pyrography rendering: scorched line burned into pale timber, tone built by dwell time from honey to charcoal, singed halo at the edges, grain deflecting every stroke, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Quilt Patchwork
styles.nl: Patchwork-quilt rendering: pieced fabric blocks, visible stitch seams and quilted relief, cotton print texture, soft batting puff, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Rainy Window Condensation
styles.nl: Rain-window rendering: water beads and runnels on glass, fogged condensation haze, refracted bokeh behind, cold ambient light, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Rangoli Powder
styles.nl: Rangoli rendering: coloured powder poured into symmetrical floor patterns, radial geometry with soft grainy borders, saturated pigment mounds catching side light, swept stone beneath, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Reaction-Diffusion Pattern
styles.nl: Reaction-diffusion rendering: spots and stripes grown by two competing chemicals, labyrinthine ridges branching and merging, soft fronts where growth meets growth, even coverage across the field, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Rust Transfer
styles.nl: Rust-transfer rendering: oxidised iron printed onto damp cloth, orange-brown bloom spreading along the weave, hard object silhouettes where metal lay, salt speckle and tide edges, material style image.
styles.negative: clean printed graphics, vivid ink colour

styles.name: [Experimental] Sand Animation Still
styles.nl: Sand-animation rendering: backlit grains on glass, forms drawn by clearing and heaping sand, warm amber glow through the layer, soft grain edges, material style image.
styles.negative: full colour rendering, hard vector edges

styles.name: [Experimental] Scanner Drag
styles.nl: Flatbed-scan rendering: subject smeared along the scan axis, banded colour streaks, hard glass-plate contact light, black void behind, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Scrimshaw
styles.nl: Scrimshaw rendering: fine incisions scratched into polished bone and rubbed with ink, tone made of hatch density alone, warm cream ground with age crazing, shallow surface sheen, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Sgraffito Plaster
styles.nl: Sgraffito rendering: coloured plaster layers scratched back to reveal the tone beneath, incised line with a raised burr, flat fields of lime colour, chipped edges and trowel marks, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Shibori Dye
styles.nl: Shibori rendering: resist-bound cloth patterns, indigo gradients bleeding at the folds, white creases, woven texture, material style image.
styles.negative: flat printed pattern, crisp vector shapes

styles.name: [Experimental] Smoke and Light
styles.nl: Smoke-and-light rendering: volumetric plumes catching a narrow beam, deep black surround, soft turbulent gradients, glowing edge scatter, material style image.
styles.negative: flat even light, hard graphic shapes

styles.name: [Experimental] Soap Carving
styles.nl: Soap-carving rendering: waxy matte block with blade facets, soft rounded edges, pastel opacity, fine shaving debris, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Soft Watercolor Deco
styles.nl: Soft deco-watercolour rendering: pale layered washes inside geometric deco framing, gold line accents, blooming pigment edges, paper grain, watercolour painting style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Stained Glass
styles.nl: Stained-glass rendering: saturated coloured panes bounded by black lead lines, backlit luminosity, glass texture and bubbles, jewel palette, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Sticker Bomb
styles.nl: Sticker-bomb rendering: overlapping die-cut decals covering every inch, peeling corners, clashing logos and colour, collage style image.
styles.negative: clean empty space, single centred subject

styles.name: [Experimental] Strange Attractor
styles.nl: Attractor rendering: one traced trajectory looped millions of times, density building luminous wings out of darkness, hairline filaments crossing, additive glow blooming where paths pile up, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Street Chalk Anamorphic
styles.nl: Pavement-chalk rendering: soft pastel dust worked into rough paving, deliberate anamorphic stretch across the slabs, joint lines cutting through the drawing, dusty bloom over the whole surface, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Sugar Glass
styles.nl: Sugar-glass rendering: brittle translucent amber sheets, sharp fracture edges, caustic light through the shards, material style image.
styles.negative: opaque matte material, dull flat light

styles.name: [Experimental] Suminagashi Marbling
styles.nl: Suminagashi rendering: concentric ink rings floated on water, drifting feathered lines, pale absorbent paper, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Tape Art
styles.nl: Tape-art rendering: image built from straight strips of coloured tape, overlapping edges and air bubbles, hard angular shapes, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Tapestry Weave
styles.nl: Tapestry rendering: interlaced warp and weft threads, stepped diagonal edges, wool colour blocks, low-relief woven texture, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Thermal Receipt
styles.nl: Thermal-receipt rendering: dithered black on faintly grey paper, monospaced print bands, faded heat streaks, curled paper edge, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Thermochromic Shift
styles.nl: Thermochromic rendering: heat-reactive pigment fading between two colours, soft blooming transitions, handprint-shaped patches, material style image.
styles.negative: fixed flat colour, hard graphic edges

styles.name: [Experimental] Tie-Dye Spiral
styles.nl: Tie-dye rendering: radiating dye spirals, bleeding colour boundaries, white resist lines, soft cotton fibre, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Truchet Tiling
styles.nl: Truchet rendering: one square tile rotated at random across a strict grid, quarter-arcs joining tile to tile into wandering continuous paths, two-tone fills, tile seams left visible, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Verre Églomisé
styles.nl: Reverse-glass rendering: gold leaf and paint applied behind glass and read through it, mirror-bright metal with engraved detail scratched into the leaf, glassy depth, dark backing sealing the panel, material style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] VHS Still
styles.nl: VHS rendering: chroma smear and bleed, tracking noise bands, soft blown highlights, interlace comb edges, tape-worn colour, video artefact style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Voronoi Fracture
styles.nl: Voronoi rendering: the plane divided into cells around scattered seed points, straight shared borders meeting at sharp junctions, cells ranging from splinters to slabs, one flat fill per cell, abstract style image.

styles.name: [Experimental] Wire Sculpture
styles.nl: Wire rendering: form drawn in bent metal line, open volumes, cast shadow doing the drawing, plain ground, material style image.
styles.negative: solid painted surfaces, flat colour fills
